notes:
CentraFlow 1.10.0 (build 20)

Conversation previews now show the latest message, its date/time and unread count. Confirmed messages show Sent; Seen means the other person opened the latest part of the conversation. Typing indicators expire automatically and stop on send or inactivity. Status updates refresh while Chat is active; they are not device-delivery guarantees.

Search messages in a conversation, including older history, with 50-result pages and selectable message text. Tap a photo to open a zoomable viewer. Save a copy uses your system file picker and runs only when requested.

The existing two-test-account restrictions and participant-only private storage remain in place. Backend additions store private read cursors and short-lived typing state; messages, planner data, notification settings and accounts are preserved. No demo records, paid upgrades or planner migration. Normal chat retains its latest-100 live window; search can page older matches. Copied/cached photos cannot be recalled by message deletion.

Conversation bubbles were reported not working and were left aside at your request; this release does not claim a bubble fix. Two-phone feature and native photo-save acceptance remains pending.

Checks: 32 Flutter regression checks passed, with an additional focused final typing rerun; isolated PostgreSQL authorization/pagination checks passed; direct Dart analysis clean. Live migration/access restrictions and unsigned-request denial verified without creating messages or read markers on behalf of either tester.

Update via Settings > App updates and confirm installation in Android. Install over the existing app without uninstalling or clearing data.

Verified APK: 120017659 bytes; SHA-256 e3b863ebba6036d4b47bc280827031fd44eb649ee96dbc6ce413eaf8f6d7d107. Original package/signing certificate, Firebase/notification resources, Inter font/license and twenty licensed FSL clips verified.
